import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 89

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="read_data",
    target="action_log.json",
    metadata={"purpose": "Data audit"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_88",
    metadata={"eval_id": 212}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
